Crime & Law · India

Lashkar terrorist killed in Shopian encounter, security forces involved

A Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist, identified as Zakir Ganie, was killed in an encounter in Shopian, Jammu and Kashmir. Police reported the operation involved the Special Operations Group, Army's Rashtriya Rifles, and CRPF. Some reports indicate the terrorist was a top commander and his body was recovered with arms after a multi-day search.
